settings.apiKeysHint: Programs from outside — an automation, an AI assistant such as Claude — talk to BauCrew through a key. Every key acts as one office account: the same role, the same view of financial data. Whoever may not see prices does not get them through the interface either.

settings.keyUserHint: An office account (administrator or manager). Crew accounts get no key.

settings.keyRevokeConfirm: Revoke key "{name}"? Programs using it will be locked out.

settings.connectApiHint: JSON over HTTPS. Every route is described in docs/API.md.
settings.connectClaudeDesktopHint: Claude Desktop reaches servers on the network through the mcp-remote bridge (needs Node.js).
settings.connectDocs: What the assistant can do: find and create projects and change their status, look up customers, employees and vehicles, read the schedule and plan assignments, read revenue by month and the plan match (with financial access only).
settings.webhooksHint: BauCrew tells an automation such as n8n what happens: a project is created, changes status, gets new dates, a new value or another site manager, or is deleted; or an invoice is ready; or somebody writes a comment. Every message is signed with the webhook's secret. If it does not arrive, BauCrew tries again after a minute, five, thirty, two hours, six and a day. The messages include prices — only administrators set up webhooks.

Several boards, so sales sees enquiries and offers and the site managers see the running sites, each on a board of its own. A project stands on every board that has a column for its status.
settings.boardNewHint: Name and columns; the order of the columns is dragged on the board itself later.

settings.boardErrorForm: Please enter a name and pick at least one column.
settings.boardDeleteConfirm: Delete board “{name}”? The projects stay — only this view goes.
settings.boardOnlyOne: The last board stays; it cannot be deleted.

settings.webhookUrlHint: The n8n webhook's production URL, not the test URL.
settings.webhookErrorUrl: Please enter a full address starting with http:// or https://.
settings.webhookRotateConfirm: The old secret stops working — n8n needs the new one.
settings.webhookDeleteConfirm: Delete webhook “{name}”? Messages not yet delivered are deleted with it.
settings.webhookDeliveriesHint: The last 40 messages. What did not arrive is retried automatically, or can be sent again here by hand.
settings.webhookAttempts: {count, plural, =0 {no attempt yet} one {# attempt} other {# attempts}}
settings.webhookHowHint: The signature is HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body with the webhook's secret. In n8n, switch on “Raw Body” in the Webhook node and compare in a Code node.
settings.webhookHowDocs: The other way round, n8n talks to BauCrew through the API — keys under
